description: IF the untreated heavily oiled Bay Jimmy plots keep retreating at the fitted long-run rate after the last survey, how much more landward edge movement is implied by 1 January 2030? Conditional projection, not a forecast.

assumptions.source: recovery_trajectories M1 long-run rate b for the untreated plots, fitted to the 4 Dec 2010 to 5 Oct 2016 surveys (1.4338, rounded to 0.01 m/yr; docs/V5_4_RECOVERY_VIEW.md)
